title: RDP lateral movement from FINANCE-07 to DC-02
verdict_rationale: A stolen valid account (corp\j.rivera) was used to RDP from FINANCE-07 into DC-02, where discovery tooling ran. Containing the destination and disabling the account stopped the pivot.
summary_text: Interactive RDP logon from FINANCE-07 to the domain controller DC-02 using corp\j.rivera, an account with no operational reason to reach DC-02. Post-logon process activity showed host and domain discovery. Determined true-positive hands-on-keyboard lateral movement (T1021.001) on a stolen valid account (T1078). Contained by isolating DC-02 and disabling the account; no evidence of persistence or data staging before containment.
